module_title: Advanced Analysis - Newly Inserted Articles and Delimitation Conditions
introduction: This advanced level explores the exact Constitutional Articles that were inserted or modified by these recent amendments, which is a favorite area for UPSC Prelims and mains-level objective questions.

core_concepts.title: Articles inserted by 101st (GST)
core_concepts.description: Inserted Article 246A (Special provision for GST), Article 269A (Levy and collection of GST in interstate trade), and Article 279A (Creation of the GST Council by the President).

core_concepts.title: Articles inserted by 102nd (NCBC)
core_concepts.description: Inserted Article 338B, which deals with the structure, duties, and powers of the NCBC (placing it on par with the SC and ST commissions). Inserted Article 342A, which deals with the President's power to notify socially and educationally backward classes.

core_concepts.title: Articles inserted by 103rd (EWS)
core_concepts.description: Amended Article 15 by adding clause (6) to allow special provisions for educational advancement of EWS. Amended Article 16 by adding clause (6) to allow up to 10% reservation in public employment for EWS.

core_concepts.title: The 'Delimitation' Catch in 106th Amendment
core_concepts.description: The 33% Women's Reservation will NOT be implemented immediately. The Act states it will only come into effect AFTER a new census is published and the subsequent 'Delimitation' (redrawing of constituencies) exercise is completed.

important_entities.name: Article 279A (GST Council)
important_entities.significance: A joint forum of the Centre and the States, chaired by the Union Finance Minister. It makes recommendations on GST rates, exemptions, and thresholds.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: The 106th Amendment does not just create a standalone 33% block. It mandates that within the existing seats reserved for SCs and STs, 33% must be horizontally reserved for women of those respective communities.

The 103rd Amendment does not 'force' state governments to provide the 10% quota. It is an enabling provision, meaning States have the discretion to decide whether or not to provide EWS reservations in state government jobs.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: SC is Base, ST adds A, OBC adds B
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Article 338 = National Commission for SCs. Article 338A = National Commission for STs. Article 338B = National Commission for BCs (added by 102nd).

exam_strategy_tips: In Assertion-Reasoning questions regarding the 106th Amendment, strictly note the condition precedent: Census first, then Delimitation, and only then implementation.
Master the 338, 338A, and 338B sequence; matching questions frequently test these three commission articles together.
